name: Todoist
description: Todoist is a task management tool allowing users to create to-do lists, set deadlines, and collaborate on projects with reminders and cross-platform syncing

tools.name: Add Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Todoist. Use when you need a separate workspace to organize projects. Generates UUID and temp_id automatically.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.about: Icon for the workspace (optional).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the new workspace.

inputs.name: uuid
inputs.about: UUID for this command for idempotency. If omitted, a new UUID is generated.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Color ID for the workspace (optional).

inputs.name: temp_id
inputs.about: Temporary identifier to map the command to the created resource. If omitted, a new UUID is generated.

tools.name: Archive Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to archive a project using Todoist API v1. For personal projects, archives it for the initiating user. For workspace projects, archives it for all workspace users.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: String ID of the project to archive.

tools.name: Bulk Create Tasks
tools.description: Create multiple Todoist tasks in one Sync batch request. Individual commands can fail even when others succeed; inspect sync_status for each command's result.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.about: Array of task specifications to create. Each task must have at minimum a 'content' field.

tools.name: Close Task (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TODOIST_CLOSE_TASK_V1 instead. This tool marks an existing task as completed in Todoist. It requires the `task_id` of the task to be closed. Closing an already-completed task returns an error; check task state first if idempotent behavior is needed.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to close (alphanumeric format from unified API v1). Verify the ID belongs to the intended task before calling, as completing the wrong task cannot be undone easily; use TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS or TODOIST_GET_TASK to confirm identity.

tools.name: Close Task (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to close (complete) a task in Todoist using API v1. Use when you need to mark a task as complete using the v1 endpoint.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: String ID of the task to close. Regular tasks are marked complete and moved to history along with their subtasks. Tasks with recurring due dates are scheduled to their next occurrence.

tools.name: Create Comment (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to create a new comment on a project or task using Todoist API v1. Use when you need to add a note to a specific task or project. IMPORTANT: You must provide EXACTLY ONE of task_id or project_id - these parameters are mutually exclusive. - To comment on a task, provide task_id (and omit project_id) - To comment on a project, provide project_id (and omit task_id) - Providing both task_id AND project_id will cause an error.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The content of the comment. Must be between 1 and 15000 characters.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to attach the comment to. IMPORTANT: Provide EITHER task_id OR project_id, but NOT BOTH. These parameters are mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: attachment
inputs.about: Attachment metadata for comments in API v1.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to attach the comment to. IMPORTANT: Provide EITHER project_id OR task_id, but NOT BOTH. These parameters are mutually exclusive.

inputs.name: uids_to_notify
inputs.about: Optional list of user IDs to notify about this comment.

tools.name: Create Label (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TODOIST_CREATE_LABEL_V1 instead. Creates a new label.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the label. Must be a non-empty string.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Color of the label. See https://developer.todoist.com/guides/#colors for available colors. Only supported integer codes from that reference are valid; arbitrary integers cause validation errors.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: The order of the label in the list.

inputs.name: is_favorite
inputs.about: Whether the label is a favorite.

tools.name: Create Label (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to create a new personal label using API v1. Use when you need to add a new label to organize tasks.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the new label. Must be between 1 and 128 characters.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Label color. Can be a color name (e.g., 'blue', 'red') or a color code (integer). Defaults to 'charcoal' if not specified.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Position of the new label in the label list. Used by clients to sort labels.

inputs.name: is_favorite
inputs.about: Whether the label is marked as a favorite. Defaults to false if not specified.

tools.name: Create Project (Deprecated)
tools.description: Creates a new Todoist project. This action is deprecated; use the returned project ID for subsequent operations to avoid ambiguous name matches.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the project. Must be non-empty; empty values cause validation failures.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Enum for project colors. Names are based on Todoist's standard palette.

inputs.name: favorite
inputs.about: Whether the project should be marked as a favorite.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: ID of the parent project to create a sub-project. If not set, it's a top-level project. Must reference an existing project ID; an incorrect value buries the project deep in the hierarchy.

inputs.name: view_style
inputs.about: Enum for project view styles.

tools.name: Create Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in Todoist using the unified API v1. Use when you need to create a new project with specific parameters like name, color, or parent project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The project name. This is the only required field.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Project color. Can be either a color name (e.g., 'berry_red', 'blue') or a numeric color code. Default is 'charcoal'.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: Parent project ID. If provided, creates this project as a sub-project. Can be either a string or integer ID.

inputs.name: view_style
inputs.about: View style of the project. Can be 'list' or 'board'.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the project. Optional field.

inputs.name: is_favorite
inputs.about: Whether the project is a favorite for the user. Default is false.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Workspace ID. If provided, creates a workspace project instead of a personal project.

tools.name: Create Section (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TODOIST_CREATE_SECTION_V1 instead. Tool to create a new section within a specific project. Use when you need to group tasks under a new heading in a project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the new section. This will be the section heading in the project.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Position of the new section in the project. Lower values appear first. If not specified, the section will be added to the end.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: ID of the project to add the section to.

tools.name: Create Section (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to create a new section within a project using API v1. Use when you need to organize tasks under a new heading in a project.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name of the new section. This will be the section heading in the project.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Position of the new section in the project. Lower values appear first. If not specified, the section will be added to the end.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: ID of the project to add the section to. Must be a new-format alphanumeric string ID. Legacy numeric project IDs are not supported by the v1 API.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Create a Todoist task with content, due dates, priority and other details in a project or section, or as a subtask. Project, section and parent task IDs consisting only of digits are rejected.

inputs.name: order
inputs.about: Non-zero integer value used to sort tasks under the same parent.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.about: The task's labels (list of names for personal/shared labels). Labels must already exist in Todoist; referencing non-existent labels may fail silently.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Task content/title. Can contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks. Do NOT include due dates or times in this field - use due_string instead.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format relative to user's timezone. Use this for exact dates without time. For natural language dates, use due_string instead. Only one due_* field can be used at a time (except due_lang). Cannot express recurrence; one-off tasks only. Use due_string (e.g., 'every Friday'

inputs.name: due_lang
inputs.about: 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for parsing due_string. Required when due_string is in a language other than English. Supported codes: da (Danish), de (German), en (English), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), fr (French), it (Italian), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), nb (Norwegian), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish),

inputs.name: duration
inputs.about: Task duration amount as a positive integer. Must be used together with duration_unit. Use this field for task duration instead of embedding 'for X minutes' in due_string. Example: for a 15-minute task, set duration=15 and duration_unit='minute'.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Task priority from 1 (normal) to 4 (urgent).

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: Parent task ID for creating subtasks. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS or TODOIST_GET_ACTIVE_TASK.

inputs.name: due_string
inputs.about: Human-defined due date in arbitrary format. Accepts natural language expressions like 'tomorrow', 'next Monday at 3pm', 'in 2 hours', 'every Friday'. Also accepts formatted dates like 'Jan 21, 2026' or ISO dates like '2026-01-21'. Value is interpreted using local time. IMPORTANT: If the due string i

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: Project ID where the task will be created. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS or TODOIST_CREATE_PROJECT. If not set, task is added to the user's Inbox. Project names are not unique; always use numeric IDs.

inputs.name: section_id
inputs.about: Section ID to put task into. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_SECTIONS.

inputs.name: assignee_id
inputs.about: The responsible user ID for shared tasks (numeric format).

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Additional notes or details about the task. Can contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks. IMPORTANT: Do NOT include due dates, times, or scheduling information here - use the due_string field for natural language dates (e.g., 'tomorrow at 2pm') or due_date/due_datetime for specific dates.

inputs.name: due_datetime
inputs.about: Specific date and time in RFC3339 format in UTC. Use this for exact date and time. Only one due_* field can be used at a time (except due_lang). Cannot express recurrence; one-off tasks only. Use due_string for recurring schedules.

inputs.name: duration_unit
inputs.about: Units for task duration in Todoist.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific comment from Todoist by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a comment.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: The ID of the comment to delete. Todoist supports alphanumeric comment IDs (e.g., '6fvWm92qwCcwhq7W').

tools.name: Delete Label (V1)
tools.description: Deletes a personal label by numeric ID using API v1. All instances of the label will be removed from tasks.

inputs.name: label_id
inputs.about: The ID of the personal label to delete. All instances of the label will be removed from tasks.

tools.name: Delete Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to delete a project and all of its sections and tasks using Todoist API v1. Use when you need to permanently remove a project by its ID.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to delete. Can be numeric or alphanumeric format.

tools.name: Delete Section (v1)
tools.description: Tool to delete a section and all tasks within it. Use when you need to permanently remove a section by its ID.

inputs.name: section_id
inputs.about: ID of the section to delete. This will delete the section and all tasks within it.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific task from Todoist. Permanently removes the task and all its subtasks with no recycle bin or undo option. Confirm with the user before executing, especially for bulk deletions.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to delete. Todoist supports both numeric IDs (e.g., '2995104339') and alphanumeric IDs (e.g., '6X4Vw2Hfmg73Q2XR').

tools.name: Delete Task (API v1)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use TODOIST_DELETE_TASK instead. Tool to delete a specific task from Todoist using API v1. Use when you need to permanently remove a task by its ID.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to delete. Todoist supports both numeric IDs (e.g., '2995104339') and alphanumeric IDs (e.g., '6fvWm74vJ773g5p4').

tools.name: Delete Upload
tools.description: Tool to delete an uploaded file from Todoist. Use when you need to remove a file that was previously uploaded.

inputs.name: file_url
inputs.about: The URL of the file to delete. This should be the full URL of the file as returned when it was uploaded (e.g., 'https://files.todoist.com/...').

tools.name: Export Template As File
tools.description: Tool to export a Todoist project as a CSV template file. Use when you need to download a project template as a file for backup or sharing.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to export as a template CSV file (alphanumeric V2 format, not numeric V1 IDs). Use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS to get valid project IDs.

inputs.name: use_relative_dates
inputs.about: Whether to use relative dates in the template (e.g., 'tomorrow' instead of specific dates). Defaults to true.

tools.name: Export Template As URL
tools.description: Tool to export a Todoist project as a shareable template URL. Use when you need to share a project structure or create copies from a template.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to export as a template (alphanumeric V2 format, not numeric V1 IDs). Use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS to get valid project IDs.

inputs.name: use_relative_dates
inputs.about: Whether to use relative dates in the template (e.g., 'tomorrow' instead of specific dates). Defaults to true.

tools.name: Filter Tasks
tools.description: Tool to get all tasks matching the filter. Use when you need to retrieve tasks based on specific filter criteria. This is a paginated endpoint using cursor-based pagination.

inputs.name: lang
inputs.about: IETF language tag defining what language filter is written in, if differs from default English.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of objects to return in a page (1-200). Default is 50.

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities in the user's account. Comma operator (,) is NOT supported. **CRITICAL: Multiple filter conditions MUST be joined with explicit logical operators (&, |, !). Space-separated filters are INVALID and w

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

tools.name: Get All Comments
tools.description: Retrieve comments for a specific Todoist task or project, providing exactly one of task_id or project_id. Returns one page in comments; use limit to set the page size and pass next_cursor as cursor with the same target for further pages.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Number of comments per page (1-200). Omit to use Todoist's default of 50.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same task_id or project_id when requesting subsequent pages.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task for which to retrieve comments. Mutually exclusive with project_id - provide only one, not both.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project for which to retrieve comments. Mutually exclusive with task_id - provide only one, not both.

inputs.name: public_key
inputs.about: Public project access key, if accessing comments on a public project. Reuse it on subsequent pages.

tools.name: Get all projects
tools.description: Get a page of active projects from a user's Todoist account. Returns projects with their id, name, color, parent, sharing status and inbox_project flag, plus a next cursor for pagination.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of projects to return per page. Defaults to server default if not provided.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Use the next_cursor value to fetch the next page of results.

tools.name: Get All Tasks
tools.description: Fetches all INCOMPLETE tasks from Todoist and returns their details. Supports cursor-based pagination. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - This endpoint only returns active (incomplete) tasks - Cannot retrieve completed tasks - use a different endpoint for that - Filter queries using 'completed', '!completed', or 'completed after' will fail - Project/label references must use ACTUAL EXISTING names from the user's account - Arbitrary text in filters causes 400 errors - use 'search: keyword' for text search Common use cases: - Get all tasks: no filter - Get today's tasks: filter="today" - Get overdue tasks: filter="overdue" - Get tasks from specific project: filter="#ProjectName" (project must exist) - Get high priority tasks: filter="p1" - Search task content: filter="search: keyword" - Paginate results: use limit and cursor parameters

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: List of task IDs to retrieve (alphanumeric string IDs).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.about: Language code for parsing date/times in queries.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The number of tasks to return per page. Default is 50.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.about: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. This endpoint only returns INCOMPLETE tasks. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities; arbitrary text causes 400 errors. Supported filters: predefined keywords ('today', 'overdue', 'no due date', etc.), priority ('p1'-'p4'), projects ('#Na

tools.name: Get Backups
tools.description: List available Todoist backup archives for the user, returning archive metadata rather than live task or project data. An empty list does not establish why backups are unavailable.

tools.name: Get Comment (V1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single comment by ID using the v1 API. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific comment.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: String ID of the comment to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Completed Tasks By Completion Date
tools.description: Tool to retrieve completed tasks within a specified completion date window. Use when you need to fetch historical completed tasks for reporting, audits, or weekly summaries. The API restricts the completion-date range to approximately 3 months between since and until parameters.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of tasks to return per page. Optional parameter. API default is 50.

inputs.name: since
inputs.about: Start date for filtering completed tasks in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Must be before 'until'. Maximum range between 'since' and 'until' is 3 months (~92 days).

inputs.name: until
inputs.about: End date for filtering completed tasks in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Must be after 'since'. Maximum range between 'since' and 'until' is 3 months (~92 days).

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Pagination cursor from previous response to fetch next page of results. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: Parent task ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fr9mHQJG3HV7gC4') to filter completed subtasks. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: Project ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fm7pCWp5Q3hhwHW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

inputs.name: section_id
inputs.about: Section ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fm7pCWp5Q3hhwHW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_SECTIONS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

inputs.name: filter_lang
inputs.about: Language code for parsing filter_query. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: filter_query
inputs.about: Filter query string using Todoist's filter syntax to further refine results. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Workspace ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6XvwwRvRfmCjM5PW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS or similar actions. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

tools.name: Get ID Mappings
tools.description: Tool to translate IDs between Todoist API v1 and v2. Use when you need to convert IDs between API versions for sections, tasks, comments, reminders, location_reminders, or projects.

inputs.name: obj_ids
inputs.about: A comma-separated list of IDs to translate. When V1 IDs are provided, the function returns corresponding V2 IDs if they exist, and vice versa. Example: '6fmCXMqW3X96q47W,6fp4f67Gvc2qvjW4'

inputs.name: obj_name
inputs.about: The type of object to map. Must be one of: sections, tasks, comments, reminders, location_reminders, projects. IDs are not unique across object types.

tools.name: Get Personal Label
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a personal label by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific personal label.

inputs.name: label_id
inputs.about: The ID of the personal label to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Productivity Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive productivity statistics for the authenticated user. Use when you need detailed completion data, karma scores, streaks, or goal tracking information for productivity reports and analysis.

tools.name: Get Project (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific project by its ID using Todoist API v1. Use when you have a project ID and need its metadata before display or update. Verify project_id matches the intended project before destructive operations — similar project names can cause mistakes; use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS to resolve ambiguous names to IDs first.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to retrieve.

tools.name: Get Full Project Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full project data including all sections, tasks, and collaborators. Use when you need comprehensive project information beyond basic metadata.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to retrieve (v2 format string ID required).

tools.name: Get Project Permissions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available roles and their associated actions in Todoist projects. Use when you need to understand what permissions different roles have in projects.

tools.name: Get Section (v1 API)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific section by its ID using Todoist v1 API. Use when you need section metadata from the v1 endpoint.

inputs.name: public_key
inputs.about: Optional public key parameter for the request

inputs.name: section_id
inputs.about: String ID of the section

tools.name: Get Special Backups
tools.description: List special backup archives for the authenticated user's projects. An empty backup list can also indicate that the backup endpoint returned HTTP 404, so it does not by itself establish that no archives exist.

tools.name: Get Task (Deprecated)
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Todoist task by ID for processing or display; this tool is deprecated. Comments and attachments with additional context require separate API calls.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to retrieve. Source from a recent TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS call to avoid stale IDs. Use this tool to confirm task identity before destructive operations (delete, close).

tools.name: Get Task (API v1)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single active (non-completed) task by ID using API v1. Use when you need to fetch task details from the v1 endpoint.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: String ID of the task to retrieve.

inputs.name: public_key
inputs.about: Optional public key for accessing shared tasks.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need user details like email, name, preferences, karma, or subscription status.

tools.name: Get Workspace Plan Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details about a workspace's current plan and usage. Use when you need information about subscription status, member count, project limits, pricing, or trial status for a specific workspace.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: ID of the workspace to retrieve plan details for.

tools.name: Import Template Into Project By ID
tools.description: Tool to import a template from Todoist's template gallery into an existing project. Use when you need to add structured tasks and sections from a pre-made template to an existing project.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: Language locale for the template content. Defaults to 'en'.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the existing project to import the template into (can be string or integer format). Use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS to get valid project IDs.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: The template identifier from Todoist's template gallery (e.g., 'project-tracker', 'gtd-weekly-review', 'meal-planning'). These IDs can be found by browsing todoist.com/templates.

tools.name: Import Template Into Project From File
tools.description: Tool to import a CSV template into an existing Todoist project from a file. Use when you need to bulk-create tasks, sections, and notes from a template file.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: The template file to upload and import. TYPE values must be lowercase: 'task', 'section', or 'note'.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to import the template into. Can be either an alphanumeric V2 format (e.g., '6fvWmP68Wchcr6RJ') or numeric V1 format. Use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS to get valid project IDs.

tools.name: Invite Project Collaborator
tools.description: Tool to invite a collaborator to a Todoist project by email. Use when the user asks to share, invite someone to, or add a collaborator to a project. For workspace or team projects, you can optionally specify a role. If the role is omitted, the workspace default role is used. For invite-only workspace projects, the caller may need admin or owner permissions; otherwise the API may return a forbidden error.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Role to assign to the collaborator in workspace/team projects. Only used for workspace projects. If omitted, the workspace default role will be applied. For personal projects, this parameter is ignored.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Email address of the person to invite as a collaborator.

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: ID of the project to share. Use TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS or TODOIST_GET_PROJECT to retrieve valid project IDs.

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: Tool to get activity logs from Todoist. Returns a paginated list of activity events for the user. Events can be filtered by object type (project, item, note), event type, and other criteria. Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient navigation through results.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of activity logs to return per page.

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results. Use the value returned in the next_cursor field from a previous response.

inputs.name: date_to
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those that occurred before this date (exclusive upper bound). Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'). When specified, overrides the default pagination behavior and allows custom date ranges.

inputs.name: date_from
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those that occurred on or after this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'). When specified, overrides the default pagination behavior and allows custom date ranges.

inputs.name: object_id
inputs.about: The ID of the specific object to get activities for. Must be used together with object_type. For example, to get activities for a specific task, set object_type=item and object_id=<task_id>.

inputs.name: event_type
inputs.about: Filter by a simple event type (e.g., "added", "deleted", "completed"). Returns events of this type across ALL object types that support it. For more precise filtering by both object type and event type, use object_event_types instead.

inputs.name: object_type
inputs.about: The type of object to filter activities by. Must be one of "project", "item" (task), or "note" (comment). When specified with object_id, returns activities for that specific object.

inputs.name: initiator_id
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those initiated by the specified user ID(s). Accepts either a single user ID or a list of user IDs. Useful for shared projects to see who made which changes.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those belonging to the specified workspace(s). Accepts either a single workspace ID or a list of workspace IDs.

inputs.name: annotate_notes
inputs.about: When true, includes additional information about comments in the extra_data field, such as the content of the comment.

inputs.name: parent_item_id
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those belonging to the specified task. Returns activities for the task itself and all its comments.

inputs.name: annotate_parents
inputs.about: When true, includes additional information about parent objects in the extra_data field, such as the name of the parent project or task.

inputs.name: ensure_last_state
inputs.about: Deprecated - This parameter has no implementation and will be removed in a future version.

inputs.name: initiator_id_null
inputs.about: Filter by whether the activity has an initiator. When true, returns only activities with no initiator (your own activities). When false, returns only activities initiated by collaborators.

inputs.name: parent_project_id
inputs.about: Filter activities to only those belonging to the specified project. Returns activities for the project itself and all its tasks and comments.

tools.name: List Completed Tasks

inputs.name: cursor

tools.name: List Completed Tasks By Due Date

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.about: Pagination cursor from previous response to fetch next page of results. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: parent_id

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: Filter tasks by project ID to get completed tasks within a specific project. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: section_id
inputs.about: Filter tasks by section ID to get completed tasks within a specific section. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: filter_lang
inputs.about: Language code for parsing filter_query. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: filter_query
inputs.about: Filter query string using Todoist's filter syntax to further refine results. Supports many Todoist filters like priority (p1-p4), labels (@labelname), and search queries. Optional parameter.

inputs.name: workspace_id

tools.name: List Filters

inputs.name: section_id

inputs.name: note

inputs.name: reminder

inputs.name: auto_reminder

tools.name: Remove Shared Label (API v1)

tools.name: Search Labels

tools.name: Todoist Sync
tools.description: Tool to sync data with Todoist server, supporting both read and write operations. This is the central endpoint used by Todoist apps for all data synchronization. Use this action to: - Read multiple resource types in a single request (projects, tasks, labels, etc.) - Perform batch write operations (create/update/delete up to 100 resources at once) - Implement efficient incremental sync using sync tokens - Execute complex multi-step operations in a single atomic request For read-only operations, pass sync_token and resource_types. For write operations, include commands array with the operations to execute. Commands support batching up to 100 operations per request.

inputs.name: commands
inputs.about: Array of write commands to execute. Supports batching up to 100 commands. Each command modifies resources (add/update/delete). Commands are executed sequentially. Use temp_id in commands to reference newly created resources within the same batch. Common command types: item_add, item_update, item_del

inputs.name: sync_token
inputs.about: Synchronization token marking the point in time of the last sync. Use '*' for full sync (retrieves all active data). For incremental sync, use the sync_token returned from the previous sync response. This enables efficient delta updates.

inputs.name: resource_types
inputs.about: Array of resource types to retrieve. Use ['all'] to fetch all resources. Specific types: 'projects', 'items', 'sections', 'labels', 'filters', 'reminders', 'notes', 'collaborators', 'user', 'live_notifications', 'user_settings', etc. Only returned resources will be included in the response.

tools.name: Unarchive Project (API v1)

inputs.name: project_id
inputs.about: The ID of the project to unarchive. Must be a valid project ID string.
